statement: The conventional c. 1250 BCE start date for the Wu Ding-era oracle bone corpus is corroborated by two independent methods: astronomical (Zhang Peiyu's analysis of five lunar-eclipse records in the "Bin group" oracle bones places Wu Ding's reign at 1250-1192 BCE) and radiocarbon (inscriptions attributed to Wu Ding dated to 1254-1197 BCE, ±10 years).

sources.citation: Keightley, David N. Sources of Shang History: The Oracle-Bone Inscriptions of Bronze Age China. University of California Press, 1978.
sources.author: David N. Keightley

sources.citation: "Radiocarbon Dating of Oracle Bones of Late Shang Period in Ancient China." Radiocarbon, Cambridge Core.
